description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Transmission Case Guide Pin.
There are a total of 2 pins located These are used in different locations around the Transmission case.
They are used to guide the housing parts into the correct location during assembly
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Guide Pins
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
